title: Disappointing Change - Minimum Balance Requirement
body:
I recently opened a zero-balance account through the ADCB bank app, attracted by the promise of no minimum balance requirements. However, I was surprised when ADCB suddenly imposed a minimum balance requirement of AED 3,000.

This change is inconvenient and costly for customers like me who initially chose the zero-balance option. It contradicts the bank's initial promise and creates unnecessary financial burdens.

Suggestions for improvement:

1. Honor the initial zero-balance promise or provide adequate notice for changes.
2. Consider waiving minimum balance requirements for certain account types.
3. Enhance transparency regarding account terms and conditions.

Overall, this change has diminished my satisfaction with ADCB. I hope the bank reconsiders its policies to better serve customers.

title: ADCB Credit Card Scam – Beware!
body:
I’ve had a frustrating experience with ADCB’s credit card. I missed the full payment for one month, but I made the minimum payment. The next month, the bank charged me a finance fee of 870 AED. The following month, I paid the full outstanding amount before the due date, but they still charged me 359 AED in finance fees.

Despite sending multiple emails to their customer service, the issue remains unresolved. Over time, I’ve lost nearly 1,200 AED due to these unjust charges.

To anyone considering applying for an ADCB credit card, think twice! This bank is not transparent with their finance charges, and it’s been an incredibly stressful experience trying to resolve this.

Please be cautious and consider other options before getting involved with ADCB!

title: Bad UX/UI
body:
The mobile banking application I've used is the worst ever.

To send money, you must laboriously add a beneficiary with extensive details, and even after that, there's no direct way to send funds.

You're forced to navigate back through slow data fetching, locate the person again, and fill in numerous fields repeatedly.

Additionally, face checking is always required, making it inconvenient if you're without proper lighting.

The UI resembles something from the 90s, and the app operates sluggishly.

Transaction history is severely lacking, with only a few recent transactions available. The transaction filter has been non-functional for the past six months.

title: Insane
body: I have had 5 bank accounts in my life. This one has been the worst and most problematic user experience I could have imagined and I greatly regret opening an account with ADCB. The app has been riddled with bugs since the moment I installed it. First, broken login. Next, I’m unable to add payees. After that, payee takes 6 hours to confirm. Finally, after payee is finally confirmed, the app blocks me from making any payments. I called customer support and account manager multiple times, and I visited the branch twice asking for help. No one could fix the problem. In order to make vital payments on time I was forced to spend hours out of each day visiting a branch and filing payments at the tiller - a minimum of an extra 2 hours per payment. This took over 1.5 weeks to resolve. Finally, I was contacted by phone to confirm a payee who was confirmed in the system over a week ago before I could finally make payments. Completely unacceptable for a bank, upon whom people depend for their livelihood and punctual payments, to be so incompetent and inefficient.
